items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I go with Clarence, with the guitar, and we go on the West Side.

ctx.x: No, but it was a big hit, and she covered the record for Capitol and got more distribution than the girl who actually made the record on a small label. We went to California to live. The people in California was angry with us, because we covered that California girl’s record. There’s a big story behind that. All right.
